title: Library Preparation for Genome-Wide DNA Methylation Profiling
author: Fei-Man Hsu

steps.title: Bench preparation and oligo handling
steps.instruction: Wipe the benchtop with DNA Zap™ PCR DNA degradation solution, let dry; fill an ice bucket; synthesize the required oligos (Adapter TOP, Adapter BOTTOM, Forward primer, Reverse primer) at the concentrations listed; reconstitute and aliquot oligos, store at –20 °C avoiding freeze‑thaw cycles; anneal adapters by mixing 10 µL Adapter TOP with 10 µL Adapter BOTTOM, run thermocycler (95 °C 2 min → 25 °C 1 min → 4 °C hold) with cooling ramp –0.1 °C/s, then aliquot 10 µL per vial and store at –20 °C.

substeps.instruction: Wipe bench with DNA Zap™ solution and wait until dry.
Fill an ice bucket.
Order/synthesize adapters and primers (Adapter TOP 20 µM methylated, Adapter BOTTOM 20 µM methylated with 5′‑phosphate, Forward primer 10 µM, Reverse primer 10 µM).
Reconstitute oligos, aliquot, store at –20 °C; avoid freeze‑thaw.
Anneal adapters: mix 10 µL TOP + 10 µL BOTTOM, thermocycle 95 °C 2 min, 25 °C 1 min (ramp –0.1 °C/s), hold 4 °C; aliquot 10 µL per tube, store at –20 °C.

steps.title: RNase A treatment of gDNA (if needed)
steps.instruction: Heat the thermomixer to 37 °C; let AMPure XP beads equilibrate at room temperature ≥30 min; prepare fresh 80 % ethanol; add RNase A to gDNA to a final 100 µg/mL and incubate 1 h at 37 °C; clean up with 1.2× AMPure XP beads, performing two 80 % ethanol washes, air‑dry 10 min, elute in 32 µL EB buffer, and assess purity (Nanodrop 260/280 = 1.8–2.0, 260/230 = 2.0–2.4) and concentration (Qubit >12 ng/µL).

substeps.instruction: Set thermomixer to 37 °C.
Remove AMPure XP beads from 4 °C, let sit RT ≥30 min.
Make fresh 80 % ethanol (Recipe 9).
Add RNase A (100 µg/mL) to gDNA, incubate 1 h at 37 °C.
Add ddH₂O to reach 100 µL total volume.
Add 120 µL (1.2×) AMPure XP beads, invert 10×, pipette 5×, incubate RT 5 min.
Place on magnetic stand 5 min, remove supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 500 µL 80 % ethanol (1 min each), then air‑dry 10 min (avoid over‑drying).
Resuspend beads in 32 µL EB buffer, incubate RT 5 min.
Magnet 5 min, transfer supernatant to new tube.
Measure DNA purity on Nanodrop (260/280 1.8–2.0; 260/230 2.0–2.4).
Quantify DNA with Qubit dsDNA BR kit; concentration must exceed 12 ng/µL.

steps.title: gDNA shearing with Covaris
steps.instruction: Thaw gDNA on ice, spike in 0.01 % lambda phage DNA, bring volume to 50 µL with ddH₂O; pre‑warm Covaris water tank to 4 °C, degas ≥30 min, load sample tube, run program (Duty cycle 10 %, intensity 10 %, cycles/burst 200, 6 cycles of 1 min each), then transfer sheared DNA to a 1.5 mL EpiTube on ice.

substeps.instruction: Thaw gDNA on ice.
Add lambda phage DNA to achieve 0.01 % of total DNA.
Add ddH₂O to a final volume of 50 µL.
Fill Covaris water tank with MilliQ water, set temperature to 4 °C.
Turn on Covaris and water tank; degas for ≥30 min.
Load the 50 µL gDNA into a Covaris microTUBE.
Mount tube in holder, ensure tube is below water surface.
Set program: Duty cycle 10 %, intensity 10 %, cycles/burst 200, 6 cycles × 1 min.
Start program; after completion, transfer sheared DNA to a 1.5 mL EpiTube and keep on ice.

steps.title: End‑repair of sheared DNA
steps.instruction: Prepare end‑repair mix (30 µL sheared DNA + 5 µL 10× end‑repair buffer + 2.5 µL end‑repair enzyme + 12.5 µL water, total 50 µL); incubate in thermocycler 20 °C 30 min, then hold 4 °C; purify with 1.5× AMPure XP beads (75 µL beads), two 200 µL 80 % ethanol washes, air‑dry 5–10 min, elute in 30 µL EB buffer.

substeps.instruction: Combine: 30 µL sheared DNA, 5 µL 10× NEBNext end‑repair buffer, 2.5 µL end‑repair enzyme mix, 12.5 µL DNase/RNase‑free water (total 50 µL).
Thermocycler: lid 30 °C, 20 °C 30 min, then 4 °C hold.
Add 75 µL AMPure XP beads (1.5×), pipette 5×, incubate RT 5 min.
Magnet 5 min, discard supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol (1 min each).
Air‑dry beads 5–10 min (do not over‑dry).
Resuspend beads in 30 µL EB buffer, incubate RT 5 min.
Magnet 5 min, transfer supernatant (end‑repaired DNA) to new tube.

steps.title: A‑tailing of end‑repaired DNA
steps.instruction: Prepare A‑tailing mix (30 µL end‑repaired DNA + 5 µL 10× NEB buffer 2 + 10 µL 1 mM dATP + 3 µL 3′→5′ Klenow exonuclease + 2 µL water, total 50 µL); incubate 37 °C 30 min (lid 40 °C), then hold 4 °C; purify with 1.5× AMPure XP beads (75 µL), two 200 µL 80 % ethanol washes, air‑dry 5–10 min, elute in 20 µL EB buffer.

substeps.instruction: Mix: 30 µL end‑repaired DNA, 5 µL 10× NEB buffer 2, 10 µL 1 mM dATP, 3 µL 3′→5′ Klenow exonuclease, 2 µL water (total 50 µL).
Thermocycler: lid 40 °C, 37 °C 30 min, then 4 °C hold.
Add 75 µL AMPure XP beads (1.5×), pipette 5×, incubate RT 5 min.
Magnet 5 min, discard supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol (1 min each).
Air‑dry beads 5–10 min (avoid over‑drying).
Resuspend beads in 20 µL EB buffer, incubate RT 5 min.
Magnet 5 min, transfer supernatant (A‑tailed DNA) to new tube.

steps.title: Adapter ligation
steps.instruction: Prepare ligation mix (20 µL 10× T4 DNA ligation buffer + 6 µL 2 µM adapter mix + 20 µL A‑tailed DNA + 1 µL T4 DNA ligase, total 30 µL); incubate overnight at 16 °C (lid 25 °C); clean up with 1.2× AMPure XP beads (add 60 µL beads after 20 µL ddH₂O to reach 50 µL total), two 200 µL 80 % ethanol washes, air‑dry 5–10 min, elute in 40 µL EB buffer.

substeps.instruction: Combine: 20 µL 10× T4 DNA ligation buffer, 6 µL adapter (2 µM), 20 µL A‑tailed DNA, 1 µL T4 DNA ligase (total 30 µL).
Incubate in thermocycler 16 °C overnight (lid 25 °C).
Add 20 µL ddH₂O to ligation mix (now 50 µL).
Add 60 µL AMPure XP beads (1.2×), pipette 5×, incubate RT 5 min.
Magnet 5 min, discard supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol (1 min each).
Air‑dry beads 5–10 min (avoid over‑drying).
Resuspend beads in 40 µL EB buffer, incubate RT 5 min.
Magnet 5 min, transfer supernatant (adapter‑ligated library) to new tube.

steps.title: Bisulfite conversion (EpiTect Fast kit)
steps.instruction: Heat thermomixer to 60 °C; add 15 µL DNA protect buffer and 85 µL bisulfite solution to each tube (final 140 µL), mix, spin, then run thermocycler program (95 °C 5 min → 60 °C 20 min → 95 °C 5 min → 60 °C 20 min → 20 °C hold); centrifuge briefly, transfer to clean 1.5 mL EpiTubes, add 310 µL buffer BL with 10 µg/mL carrier RNA, mix, add 250 µL absolute ethanol, mix, load onto MinElute spin columns, perform washes (500 µL buffer BW, 500 µL buffer BD with 15 min RT incubation, repeat BW wash twice), final 250 µL ethanol wash, dry column at 60 °C, elute with 16 µL EB buffer, centrifuge, collect eluate.

substeps.instruction: Set thermomixer to 60 °C.
To each tube add 15 µL DNA protect buffer + 85 µL bisulfite solution (total 140 µL); mix, brief spin.
Thermocycler program (lid 100 °C): 95 °C 5 min, 60 °C 20 min, 95 °C 5 min, 60 °C 20 min, then 20 °C hold.
Brief centrifugation, transfer reaction to clean 1.5 mL EpiTubes.
Add 310 µL freshly prepared buffer BL containing 10 µg/mL carrier RNA; mix, brief spin.
Add 250 µL absolute ethanol, mix, brief spin.
Load mixture onto MinElute spin column; centrifuge 16,000 g 1 min, discard flowthrough.
Wash: add 500 µL buffer BW, centrifuge 16,000 g 1 min, discard flowthrough.
Add 500 µL buffer BD, incubate 15 min RT (lid closed).
Centrifuge 16,000 g 1 min, discard flowthrough.
Repeat BW wash two more times (total three washes).
Add 250 µL absolute ethanol, centrifuge 16,000 g 1 min, discard flowthrough.
Place column in clean 1.5 mL EpiTube, open lid, incubate on 60 °C thermomixer to evaporate residual liquid.
Elute DNA: add 16 µL EB buffer to column center, incubate 1 min, centrifuge 16,000 g 1 min.
Transfer eluate (bisulfite‑converted DNA) to new PCR tube.

steps.title: Library amplification (PCR)
steps.instruction: Thaw 10 mM dNTPs and 10× Pfu Turbo Cx buffer on ice; prepare amplification mix (2.5 µL 0.5 µM forward primer, 2.5 µL 0.5 µM reverse primer, 1 µL 10 mM dNTPs, 5 µL 10× Pfu Turbo Cx buffer, 1 µL Pfu Turbo Cx hot‑start polymerase, 22 µL water, 16 µL bisulfite‑converted DNA; total 50 µL); thermocycle (lid 100 °C): 95 °C 2 min; 6–10 cycles of 95 °C 15 s, 63 °C 15 s, 72 °C 30 s; finish with 72 °C 2 min, hold 4 °C; purify PCR product with 0.8× AMPure XP beads (add 80 µL beads after 100 µL ddH₂O to reach 100 µL total), two 200 µL 80 % ethanol washes, air‑dry 5–10 min, elute in 40 µL EB buffer.

substeps.instruction: Thaw 10 mM dNTP mix and 10× Pfu Turbo Cx buffer on ice.

Mix amplification components: 2.5 µL forward primer (0.5 µM), 2.5 µL reverse primer (0.5 µM), 1 µL 10 mM dNTPs, 5 µL 10× Pfu Turbo Cx buffer, 1 µL Pfu Turbo Cx hot‑start polymerase, 22 µL DNase/RNase‑free water, 16 µL bisulfite‑converted DNA (total 50 µL).
Thermocycler program (lid 100 °C): 95 °C 2 min; then 6–10 cycles of 95 °C 15 s, 63 °C 15 s, 72 °C 30 s; final extension 72 °C 2 min; hold 4 °C.
Add 50 µL ddH₂O to the PCR product (total 100 µL).
Add 80 µL AMPure XP beads (0.8×), pipette 5×, incubate RT 5 min.
Magnet 5 min, discard supernatant.
Wash beads twice with 200 µL 80 % ethanol (1 min each).
Air‑dry beads 5–10 min (avoid over‑drying).
Resuspend beads in 40 µL EB buffer, incubate RT 5 min.
Magnet 5 min, transfer supernatant (amplified library) to a clean 1.5 mL EpiTube.

steps.title: Qubit library quantification
steps.instruction: Prepare Qubit working solution (1 µL Qubit reagent + 199 µL Qubit buffer, total 200 µL); set up assay tubes (include two extra tubes for standards); add 190 µL working solution to each standard tube, 10 µL standard; add 198 µL working solution to each sample tube, 2 µL library; vortex, incubate RT 2 min, read on Qubit fluorometer.

substeps.instruction: Mix 1 µL Qubit reagent with 199 µL Qubit buffer (200 µL total).
Label Axygen PCR‑05‑C tubes for standards and samples (include two extra standard tubes).
Add 190 µL working solution to each standard tube, then 10 µL Qubit standard.
Add 198 µL working solution to each sample tube, then 2 µL library.
Vortex tubes briefly, spin down 2 min at RT.
Measure fluorescence on Qubit fluorometer; record concentrations.

steps.title: TapeStation library quantification
steps.instruction: In a TapeStation tube strip, add 1 µL DNA ladder to 3 µL D1000 sample buffer (position A1); add 1 µL library to 3 µL D1000 sample buffer in another well; vortex at 2000 rpm for 1 min, spin 1 min, load strip into TapeStation, start assay; evaluate size distribution (ideal 300–400 bp, avoid adapter dimer ~130 bp).

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL D1000 ladder to 3 µL D1000 sample buffer in tube A1.
Add 1 µL library to 3 µL D1000 sample buffer in a separate tube.
Vortex mixture at 2000 rpm for 1 min (IKA MS3).
Spin strip for 1 min.
Load strip into TapeStation instrument, place ladder in position A1.
Start assay and review electropherogram; confirm library peak 300–400 bp and absence of ~130 bp adapter dimer.
